title: CRE F3-F7 finder-freeze artifact schemas (threat model: single-author integrity)
description: Every artifact is a $defs member with an artifact_type discriminator; root is a oneOf. A strict byte loader (reject duplicate keys and any float token e.g. 1.0 before parse) and a versioned semantic validator (hash agreement, funnel/reportability equations, canonical ordering+uniqueness, chain/WAL linkage, git reachability+ancestry, RFC3339 semantics, percent-encode round-trip, numeric ranges, cross-field timeout/backoff, candidate==selection correspondence, module role/path exhaustiveness, trusted-constant comparison for repo_identity/canonical_ref) are REQUIRED in addition. Filename digests (config_hash, run_hash) are not fields. Envelope digests exclude themselves.

git_commit_oid.$comment: Semantic validator proves this names a COMMIT object (not tree/blob).

candidate_protocol.$comment: Codex v9 #2: committed BEFORE candidate-config creation. Binds the predeclared freeze criterion, prohibited-case set, and the exact schema+validator contract, so 'predeclared' is provable (not written into a later artifact). CONFIG references candidate_protocol_sha256.

prohibited_cases.$comment: minItems 2: the two known confirmed F3 cases (Seeman, idelalisib) must always be present. Keyed on citing_pmcid (the durable contamination key); citation_id and occurrence_identity are optional provenance — requiring them would demand inputs ZD does not have yet (cases known by PMID). Semantic validator (SV-043) enforces uniqueness by citing_pmcid.

schema_sha256.$comment: content hash of THIS schema file, so CONFIG binds the exact validation contract (Codex v9 P1).

exposure_plan.$comment: Committed AFTER BATCH finalization but BEFORE any output is revealed in the UI; identifies the exact review records exposed. PROMOTION references this artifact by exposure_plan_sha256 (the older predeclared_exposure_shas array was removed in v10). Introducing commit records the pre-UI time.

runtime_observation.$comment: Reusable; run_state_manifest.observed_runtime_sha256 = SHA256(canon_v1(this)); BATCH embeds the same object.

idempotency_preimage.$comment: The LITERAL object hashed for idempotency_key = SHA256(canon_v1(this)). claim_idx is null for the extraction stage.

iso8601_tz.$comment: Semantic RFC 3339 (real date, valid offset) enforced by the semantic validator.

citation_id.$comment: Semantic validator: canonical UTF-8 percent decode/re-encode equality (rejects %ZZ, wrong hex case, doubly-encoded %); item_key == citing_pmcid + ':' + pctencode(ref_id).

run_id.$comment: 128-bit hex, generated once per run; unique (semantic).

host_allowlisted.$comment: Semantic validator confirms host ∈ project allowlist.

retry_policy.$comment: Semantic validator: total_timeout >= max(connect,read); backoff_cap >= backoff_base; retry_after_cap relevant only if respect_retry_after.

no_decimal_param.$comment: Codex v8 #7: supplied decimal params would send a JSON float, breaking exact-request hashing under float-prohibition. Decimal params (temperature, top_p) MUST be omitted/provider_default/unsupported — never supplied. Matches the Opus adapter, which omits temperature.

safe_int_param.$comment: I-JSON safe integer range for seed etc.

model_snapshot.$comment: Any pinned provider snapshot id. The old pattern .*-[0-9]{8}$ baked in one provider's dated-snapshot naming and would reject valid pinned ids without a date suffix (e.g. claude-opus-5). Pinning discipline is preserved semantically: the value must equal the ZD-supplied snapshot string in the CANDIDATE_PROTOCOL era CONFIG, and the provider-returned model id must equal it at run time (model_mismatch otherwise).

response_schema_sha256.$comment: Residual #5 delta: content hash of the committed per-stage response-schema file. null until ZD supplies/approves the response schemas (input #1); while null, SV-024 validates shape presence only and says so in its violation message.

Residual #5 delta: content hash of the committed per-stage response-schema file. null until ZD supplies/approves the response schemas (input #1); while null, SV-024 validates shape presence only and says so in its violation message.

prompt_package.$comment: self_hash_exclusion: package_sha256. Slot sets are LOCKED (Codex-verified target placeholders); no 'provisional'.

template_text_version.$comment: Frozen historical text version (Codex final-pass Q1.3).
Frozen historical text version (Codex final-pass Q1.3).

candidate_protocol_sha256.$comment: Binds the pre-committed CANDIDATE_PROTOCOL (freeze criterion + prohibited set + schema/validator contract).

source.$comment: Semantic validator compares repo_identity & canonical_ref to out-of-band TRUSTED constants; CONFIG cannot nominate its own trust root.

source_commit_oid.$comment: Residual #10 delta: must name a COMMIT object; the semantic validator (SV-041) proves source_tree_oid IS this commit's tree.

module_manifest.$comment: Semantic validator: exhaustive role coverage; unique (role,repo_path); no duplicate path with differing hash. Pre-import byte-verify.

batch.$comment: FINAL-ONLY. run_hash = SHA256(canon_v1(this)); filename only. In-progress → run_state_manifest.

genesis_preimage.$comment: The actual structured preimage; genesis = SHA256(canon_v1(genesis_preimage)).

review_dump_sha256.$comment: Codex v8 #10: sidecar removed; the review-record chain (seq/prev/record_sha256) is the recovery structure; chain_tip recomputable from the dump.

allOf.$comment: Codex v10 #8: mode matrix. candidate→calibration + no promotion-at-start; release→formal + promotion-at-start present; development→never here (only run_state).
A development run never produces a BATCH artifact (unattested, nonreportable).

run_state_manifest.$comment: Mutable during a run; binds every immutable input + durable checkpoint so resume cannot switch the dataset.

observed_runtime.$comment: Codex v8 #8/#12: the actual object is embedded here AND its content hash recorded, so the stored hash references a defined artifact.

allOf.$comment: Codex final-pass Q1.1: the execution-mode matrix applies to run-state too, not only BATCH. development run-state is permitted (a development run has in-progress state but never produces a BATCH).

wal_event.$comment: Immutable event-sourced record. Genuinely CLOSED oneOf per event_type (Codex v9 #1): each branch sets its own required/forbidden/const fields, additionalProperties:false. event_sha256 = SHA256(canon_v1(event∖event_sha256)). Retryability governed by sent_boundary_crossed. SV-023: the 'prepared' branch requires the literal idempotency_preimage.

oneOf.$comment: PREPARED: pre-send; carries the idempotency preimage (SV-023); boundary false; no response fields.
SENT: request bytes may have left; boundary true; no response yet.
TRANSPORT_FAILED: known pre-send failure; boundary false; nonempty exception; safe to retry.

RESPONSE_PERSISTED: boundary true; preserves transport facts. Provider model/response/finish are REQUIRED-NULLABLE (string|null) — a 4xx/5xx body has none, but the fields are always present so there are no byte-distinct equivalent states (Codex v10 WAL #2). The OK review_call requires the model audit separately.
INDETERMINATE: ambiguous post-send; boundary true; must link the prior durable 'sent' event via prev_attempt_terminal_sha256; item quarantined.

review_call.$comment: Discriminated on (call_made,status). Wrapped by coverage_item / used directly for extract. retry_wal_event_shas are ordered unique WAL event hashes.

oneOf.$comment: model_mismatch requires the returned model id.
provider_error / refusal / truncated / malformed: preserve HTTP status, body, headers.
timeout is TERMINAL only when PRE-SEND (connect). read is post-send and total may be either → both become indeterminate, never a terminal timeout (Codex v10 WAL #3).
transport_error = exhausted pre-send failure (DNS/TLS/connect) with no HTTP response (Codex v8 #6).
empty distinguishes zero-byte body from valid empty provider result.
indeterminate identifies the WAL event proving the ambiguous send; item is quarantined.

stimulus_object.$comment: The exact object rendered to the annotator; stimulus_sha256 = SHA256(canon_v1(this)). No forbidden fields (leakage audit).

worksheet_schema.$comment: Closed; recursively free of forbidden provenance fields (SV-070). SV: question ids unique (semantic).

codebook_content.$comment: Embedded so the UI truly renders solely from this object (Codex v8 #8).

review_record.$comment: One JSONL line per item; run-time FACTS only. coverage: one coverage_item per extracted claim, contiguous 0..n-1. Excluded → stimulus/evidence null.

seq.$comment: Position in the review chain; chain_tip recomputable from records. genesis is seq -1's prev.

record_sha256.$comment: = SHA256(canon_v1(record∖record_sha256)); chained via prev_record_sha256; tip = last record_sha256.

selection_artifact.$comment: Committed BEFORE first output; sha256 in genesis preimage. Semantic: len>=min_size; coverage met; unique citation_id AND occurrence_identity; canonical sort by citation_id.

occurrence_identity_version.$comment: Codex v9 #4 (contradiction removed): occurrence_identity is computed from the CURRENT normalized key and is NOT claimed stable across a later resolution — a resolution change yields a NEW occurrence_identity. This is acceptable because contamination protection does NOT depend on it: exclusion is applied citing-paper-wide keyed on citing_pmcid, so the paper stays excluded regardless of key drift. Precedence resolved_pmid > resolved_doi > normalized_citation_string.

normalization_contract_sha256.$comment: content hash of the pinned normalization algorithm (DOI lowercase + strip URL prefix; NFC; whitespace/punct collapse; author/title/year rule).

normalized_ref_key.$comment: canonical value under the pinned contract.

occurrence_identity.$comment: = SHA256(canon_v1({occurrence_identity_version, citing_pmcid, normalized_ref_key_type, normalized_ref_key})) — these four members EXACTLY, keyed by these field names; normalization_contract_sha256 is deliberately NOT in the preimage (it is stored alongside for recomputability; the contract is versioned via occurrence_identity_version). PROVENANCE/dedup aid only, NOT the contamination key and NOT claimed stable across resolution — exclusion is citing-paper-wide on citing_pmcid (closed decision). Matches SV-061 verbatim (Codex final-pass Q2.2).

source_occurrence_fingerprint.$comment: = SHA256(canon_v1({source_xml_sha256, ref_content_utf8, extraction_contract_version})); PROVENANCE only, snapshot-dependent.

stratum.$comment: Residual #3 delta — PROPOSED, pending ZD approval with the selection-rule input (#2): names the coverage_targets key this item counts toward. SV-033 enforces value ∈ coverage_targets keys and per-target counts when items carry strata; ZD may instead demote coverage_targets to informational. Optional until ZD decides.

candidate_manifest.$comment: Semantic validator: items exactly equal the selection artifact's ordered item set (same citation_ids, same order).

exclusion_ledger_entry.$comment: Append-only; seq contiguous from 0; prev chain; entry_sha256 = SHA256(canon_v1(entry∖entry_sha256)). Every human-inspected calibration item is excluded citing-paper-wide.

promotion.$comment: Codex v10 #2: PROMOTION REFERENCES the pre-committed artifacts by hash (no duplication, no opaque array). Semantic validator walks these: candidate_protocol_sha256 == CONFIG's; exposure_plan.run_hash == run_hash and every exposure row ∈ the run's review chain; post_exposure_exclusion_checkpoint_sha256 (N+1) strictly newer than the candidate BATCH's N and citing-paper-wide covers every exposure row; the exposure_plan commit precedes UI access; freeze criterion is the protocol's (not restated); target BATCH is candidate/calibration under the same CONFIG.

revocation.$comment: Blocks future releases as of the introducing commit (ancestry order). No retroactive invalidation.

annotation_release_manifest.$comment: The annotation DENOMINATOR: flagged + validator-eligible rows ONLY (not a full-run inventory); eligibility DERIVED not stored; sorted by citation_id, unique by citation_id AND occurrence_identity. Bound to its PRODUCING FORMAL run (source_run_hash + source_review_dump_sha256 + source_selection_hash); each row cites review_record_sha256 + seq and the validator proves the row ∈ that exact release-mode/formal BATCH review chain. Empty inventory permitted → precision reported as undefined.

release_attestation.$comment: Two-phase: (1) commit all referenced inputs; (2) build attestation referencing that parent commit; (3) commit attestation; (4) semantic validator requires the introducing commit's IMMEDIATE PARENT to equal canonical_ref_commit (not merely a descendant — SV-041; no revocation or ledger change can slip in between), and reachable from the canonical ref. valid_at_release is const true (a failed validation is not an attestation).

prereg_amendment_sha256.$comment: F3-DI2 preregistration amendment; publication dependency (see spec Out of scope).
